items.title: Voice dictation
items.summary: A microphone button in the composer lets you dictate: words appear while you speak. It runs on the Mac itself, with no cloud and no API key. A new Settings page controls it.

features.name: Live dictation in the composer
features.what: Before: no voice input in the composer. Now: a mic button next to Send starts recording, and the words show up in the editor while you speak (grey text is still being corrected). Click again to stop; the final text stays at the cursor and is NOT sent.
features.how: Click the mic button, or tap Space (under 250 ms) in the empty, focused composer. Tap Space or click again to stop. Option-click on the mic switches between PT and EN.

features.name: Settings > Dictation
features.what: Before: no dictation settings. Now: a new Dictation item in the Personal group of Settings lets you pick the engine (Apple Speech or Apple Dictation), the language, and test the microphone for 3 seconds.
features.how: Open Settings > Dictation, or right-click the mic button in the composer. Press Test to record 3 seconds and see the text.

items.title: Extra High effort and model names
items.summary: Adds an Extra High effort level for Opus 5 and removes the " 1M" suffix from model names, showing a small "1M ctx" tag only when needed.

features.name: Extra High effort for Opus 5
features.what: Before: the Effort menu stops at High and Max for Opus 5. Now: an Extra High item sits between High and Max; picking it is saved like the other levels and the button shows "Extra High".
features.how: Pick Opus 5 in the composer, open the Effort menu and choose Extra High.

features.name: Model names without " 1M"
features.what: Before: names like "Opus 5 1M" mix the model with its context size. Now the suffix is hidden; when both Opus 5 and Opus 5 1M exist, the 1M one gets a small "1M ctx" tag so the two items are not identical.
features.how: Automatic, in the model menus and buttons of the composer, Agents editor and Settings.

items.title: Background tasks in the chat
items.summary: Background tasks now show inside the conversation as a block at the end of the transcript, not only in the composer pill.

features.name: Task block that updates live
features.what: Before: running tasks were only in the "N Tasks Running" pill. Now: a block after the last message lists each task with a spinner, a type chip (bash, agent, workflow...) and a live timer. Finished tasks show their result and duration for 8 seconds.

features.name: Folded summary line
features.what: Before: nothing remained after tasks ended. Now: finished tasks fold into one line like "3 background tasks done - 1 failed" that stays until your next message. Click it to see the rows again.
features.how: Click the summary line to expand it.

items.title: Agent Runs panel
items.summary: A floating, read-only panel shows your agent runs: totals, status breakdown, average duration and cost.

features.name: Open with Cmd+Shift+A
features.what: Before: no overview of agent runs. Now: Cmd+Shift+A opens a panel with total runs, active now, average duration, total cost and a bar per status (completed, failed, running, queued, cancelled). It only reads data from your logged-in account.
features.how: Press Cmd+Shift+A to open or close. Esc or the X closes it.
